newsitem.title: USA: Xerox copier launched, color business rises.
newsitem.headline: Xerox copier launched, color business rises.

text.p: Xerox Corp said Thursday that its color business had expanded at twice the industry average last year and that it expected that pace to continue through 1997.
It also introduced its lowest cost digital copier/printer, the Xerox DocuColor 5750.
Xerox has priced the DocuColor 5750 under $20,000 and to make the copier available beginning next month in North America, South America and Europe.
Later this year, the company plans to announce more new desktop and the production environment it says will "remove additional price, productivity and quality barriers in the use of business color."
